name: Faerie Dragon Muisek
summary: West of Witch Doctor Uzer'i, the Horde seeks the spirits of faerie dragons. Sprite darters and sprite dragons bear the strength Uzer'i hopes to capture.

sections.title: Fragile Looks, Strong Spirit
sections.body: Witch Doctor Uzer'i sees strength in faerie dragons, though they look delicate. They have long been allies to the night elves, and Uzer'i wants the Horde to share their power. Uzer'i gives you a Muisek Vessel and sends you west. Slay eight sprite darters or sprite dragons, then use the vessel on each fallen faerie dragon to shrink and capture its spirit.

sections.title: Back at Uzer'i's Side
sections.body: When you return with the captured spirits, Witch Doctor Uzer'i thanks you. The Horde can now draw on the faerie dragons' spiritual power. Uzer'i hopes you will agree to one more job.

faq.q: Why does Witch Doctor Uzer'i want faerie dragon spirits?
faq.answer: Uzer'i says faerie dragons look fragile but hold a powerful spirit. They have long been allies to the night elves, and Uzer'i wants the Horde to benefit from their strength too.

faq.q: Where can the faerie dragons be found?
faq.answer: The faerie dragons lie west of Witch Doctor Uzer'i.

aliases: what do i kill for faerie dragon muisek
faq.answer: Sprite darters and sprite dragons provide the muisek. You need to kill and capture eight of them.

faq.q: What must be done to the fallen creatures?
aliases: how to get faerie dragon muisek
faq.answer: Use the Muisek Vessel on each fallen faerie dragon to shrink it and capture its muisek.

faq.q: Where does this step fit among Uzer'i's requests?
aliases: what is next after faerie dragon muisek
faq.answer: This step follows Hippogryph Muisek. Treant Muisek follows it.
